intent: Task completion as a bar or circle from 0 to 100. One piece. Optional name label. Percent overlay, end, or in the ring hole. Tones brand, danger, muted. Sizes sm, md, lg. Fill grows once on load.
useWhen: A determinate percent in a form, card, or page
A determinate percent as a ring or semicircle
doNotUseWhen: A spinner with no known percent — not this component
A rating out of 5 — that stays a Cell type
Part-to-whole share across segments — use PieChart

size.note: Bar track height: sm is space-1, md is space-2, lg is space-3. Overlay uses space-5. Circle and semicircle: sm 56, md 96, lg 196.

shape.note: bar is the track. circle is a donut ring. semicircle is a bottom U gauge: 0 to 100 maps onto 180 degrees, not a cropped 360 degree ring. Same piece. Size sets the ring, not bar height.

label.note: Visible name above the track. Prefer this over ProgressLabel.

showValue.note: Shows the rounded percent. Overlay sits on the bar. End sits after the bar, or in meta when a name label is set. Circle puts it in the hole. Semicircle puts it in the bowl.

valuePosition.note: Bar only. overlay centers the percent on the track. end puts it after the bar, or opposite a name label in the meta row. Circle uses the hole. Semicircle uses the bowl.

ariaLabel.note: Required when label is omitted. Cell passes the percent or its label.

requirements: role=progressbar on the track or ring
Visible label uses aria-labelledby; unlabeled needs ariaLabel

doNot: Do not invent ProgressLabel, ProgressValue, ProgressTrack, ProgressIndicator, or ProgressRoot
Do not invent MeterCircle or ProgressCircle
Do not use PieChart for a determinate percent ring
Do not use img assets for the ring
Do not add threshold-zone rings, datatip, or reference lines
Do not use a native progress element
Do not add a multi-segment status bar
Do not skip prefers-reduced-motion on the load animation
snippet:
<Progress value={33} />
<Progress value={56} label="Upload progress" showValue />
<Progress value={50} showValue valuePosition="overlay" />
<Progress value={50} showValue tone="danger" />
<Progress value={50} shape="circle" showValue />
